---
name: Change proposal
about: Propose a change or addition to the OpenBook specification or vocabularies
title: "proposal: "
labels: proposal
---

## Summary
One or two sentences: what should change.

## Motivation
What real feed(s) or use case motivates this? Cite at least one publicly
documented source (a book or aggregator that carries the sport / market /
segment / field).

## Proposal
The concrete change: fields, enum values, or objects. Prefer the smallest
change that solves the problem.

## Compatibility
Is this additive (minor) or breaking (major)? What does it do to existing
publishers and consumers?

## Alternatives considered
What else was on the table, and why this instead.
